largest_object_moves.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
      (define (axis-shift lo hi target-lo target-hi)
        (cond ((< hi target-lo) (- target-lo hi 1))
              ((> lo target-hi) (- (+ target-hi 1) lo))
              (else 0)))
      (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
             (red (find (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) objs))
             (cyan (find (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 8)) objs))
             (move-red? (>= (obj-size red) (obj-size cyan)))
             (mover (if move-red? red cyan))
             (anchor (if move-red? cyan red))
             (a (obj-bbox mover)) (b (obj-bbox anchor))
             (raw-dr (axis-shift (first a) (third a) (first b) (third b)))
             (raw-dc (axis-shift (second a) (fourth a) (second b) (fourth b)))
             (dr raw-dr) (dc raw-dc)
             (base (recolor-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
                                  (obj-cells anchor) (obj-color anchor))))
        (for/fold ((out base)) ((cell (in-list (obj-cells mover))))
          (set-cell out (+ (first cell) dr) (+ (second cell) dc) (obj-color mover))))))

one_axis_larger_gap.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
      (define (axis-shift lo hi target-lo target-hi)
        (cond ((< hi target-lo) (- target-lo hi 1))
              ((> lo target-hi) (- (+ target-hi 1) lo))
              (else 0)))
      (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
             (red (find (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) objs))
             (cyan (find (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 8)) objs))
             (move-red? #t)
             (mover (if move-red? red cyan))
             (anchor (if move-red? cyan red))
             (a (obj-bbox mover)) (b (obj-bbox anchor))
             (raw-dr (axis-shift (first a) (third a) (first b) (third b)))
             (raw-dc (axis-shift (second a) (fourth a) (second b) (fourth b)))
             (dr (if (>= (abs raw-dr) (abs raw-dc)) raw-dr 0)) (dc (if (< (abs raw-dr) (abs raw-dc)) raw-dc 0))
             (base (recolor-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
                                  (obj-cells anchor) (obj-color anchor))))
        (for/fold ((out base)) ((cell (in-list (obj-cells mover))))
          (set-cell out (+ (first cell) dr) (+ (second cell) dc) (obj-color mover))))))
